data.one_liner: Command-line tool to easily increment version numbers in pubspec.yaml files.
data.what_it_does: Pub_version_plus provides a command-line utility to increment major, minor, patch, and build numbers within a pubspec.yaml file. It supports flags for handling pre-releases and customizing build number modifications.
use_when: You want to automate version bumping in your CI/CD pipelines.
You need a quick CLI command to increment pubspec.yaml versions locally.
avoid_when: You need a version management library that works programmatically inside your application runtime rather than as a build/dev tool.
strengths: Supports multiple increment types (major, minor, patch, build).
Can be used globally or as a dev dependency in CI/CD.
Provides flexible build number options (reset, remove, increment, none).
weaknesses: Limited to modifying pubspec.yaml version formats.
data.setup_notes: Install globally via pub/flutter or add it as a dev dependency in pubspec.yaml.
